                                   Resolution 2022-02

                      Of the Girdwood Board of Supervisors
   A RESOLUTION IN SUPPORT OF DESIGN, ENGINEERING AND CONSTRUCTION OF A
     SUSPENSION BRIDGE TO REPLACE THE HAND TRAM TO SPAN GLACIER CREEK

WHEREAS, the hand tram at Glacier Creek has been an iconic element of Girdwood Trails since it was permitted and constructed in
the 1990’s; and

WHEREAS, over the past 20 years, use of the Winner Creek Trail has exceeded the capacity of the hand tram, resulting in review of
alternatives that will match trail use, provide year-round access, and will be accessible by all trail users; and

WHEREAS, Girdwood Trails Committee has recommended study, design and construction of a suspension bridge to provide crossing
of Glacier Creek in the location of the current hand tram, which will require removal of the hand tram components and use of one of
the existing tram terminal buildings to house an interpretive display to commemorate the concept, engineering and construction of the
hand tram; and

WHEREAS, the Girdwood Valley Service Area is working closely with partner organizations, including Anchorage Parks and
Recreation, Municipality of Anchorage, Heritage Land Bank, US Forest Service and Alaska State Parks, as well as other regional
organizations and groups to assist in bringing this ambitious project to completion; and

WHEREAS, the Girdwood Trails Committee voted 51 in favor, 0 opposed at their January 4, 2022 meeting and the Girdwood Land
Use Committee voted 10 in favor, 0 opposed at their January 10, 2022 meeting to recommend this Resolution of Support;


THEREFORE, the Girdwood Board of Supervisors commits to allocating funding from the Girdwood Parks and Recreation Capital
Account in the amount of $500,000, matched with funds committed by the Municipality of Anchorage Parks and Recreation
Department, to support the design, engineering and construction of a suspension bridge to replace the Hand Tram to span Glacier
Creek and creation of an interpretive display to commemorate the Hand Tram.

Passed and approved by a vote of 4 to 0 this 17th day of January 2022 and amended this 14th day of February 2022.


                                                                    February 14, 2022
Briana Sullivan, GBOS Parks and Rec Supervisor                   DATE
